channel.title: Strictly Come Dancing
channel.desc: It's a big night in the ballroom as this year's competition nears its climatic conclusion. Tess and Claudia welcome the remaining couples to the 2025 semi-final, where they must dance twice to win a place in the grand final. Judges Shirley Ballas, Craig Revel Horwood, Motsi Mabuse and Anton Du Beke will once again provide their critiques along with the scores before the vote opens at the end of the show. Who will you decide deserves to be a finalist?
